provenance_path_semantics.source_artifact_relative_path: Authoring-workspace relative path, not a repository path or ZIP member path.
provenance_path_semantics.archive_resolution: Use only the exact Library identity/version and member_path listed in provenance_archive_map; mappings verified by SHA256 and byte length, including all matching duplicate members.
provenance_path_semantics.unarchived_sources: The repository preserves source-SHA-linked excerpts. Complete originals of entries marked not_archived_authoring_workspace_only remain only in the authoring workspace; no complete downloadable original is promised.

public_path_normalization.operation: Strip the author-machine absolute workspace prefix from artifact path strings; output paths are relative to the hero_weapon_grips authoring-artifact root.
public_path_normalization.not_a_repo_or_archive_path: Use provenance_archive_map.member_path for archive lookup; normalized value strings describe original artifact relationships.
public_path_normalization.preserved: All non-path values, numeric measurements, source SHA256 and source byte lengths remain unchanged. SHA256 provenance always identifies the unchanged original report bytes, not the normalized excerpt bytes.
public_path_normalization.originals: No source report, source ZIP, art file, texture, image or video was modified for this public-text normalization.
